function minimax(board: Board): [number, number] {
  // Check if the current player can win
  if (checkWin(board)) {
    return [0, 0];
  }

  // Check if the game is over
  if (checkGameOver(board)) {
    return [1, -1];
  }

  // Check if it's a draw
  if (checkDraw(board)) {
    return [1, -1];
  }

  // Determine current player
  let currentPlayer = 'X';
  
  // Try all possible moves
  let bestMove = [0, 0];
  
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    const cell = board[i];
    const index = cell === 'X' ? '0' : '1';
    
    // Place the current player on the cell
    board[i] = cell;
    
    // Recursively call minimax
    const result = minimax(board);
    
    // Update the best move based on the result
    if (currentPlayer === 'X') {
      bestMove[0] = result[0];
      bestMove[1] = result[1];
    } else {
      bestMove[0] = result[0];
      bestMove[1] = -result[1];
    }
    
    // Undo the move
    board[i] = cell;
  }

  return bestMove;
}
```
